skills.name: search-businesses
skills.description: Find businesses on LocalePak by keyword, city, or category using the site's public search and listing pages.

skills.name: browse-categories
skills.description: Browse the 24 business categories on LocalePak and open a category page to see its listings.

skills.name: browse-cities
skills.description: Browse the 183 cities covered by LocalePak and open a city or city-by-category page to see local listings.

skills.name: read-business-profile
skills.description: Read a single business profile page for its phone number, address, services, and customer reviews.

skills.name: use-public-api
skills.description: Read public listings as JSON via the free read-only API: GET /api/v1/businesses?q=&city=&category=, /api/v1/businesses/<slug>, /api/v1/categories, /api/v1/cities. No key needed; max 20 results per page, 60 requests/minute per IP. Spec: https://www.localepak.com/openapi.json.

skills.name: use-mcp-server
skills.description: Use the MCP server at /api/mcp (Streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC): tools search_businesses, get_business, list_categories, list_cities. Read-only, no authentication. Server card: https://www.localepak.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json.

skills.name: read-blog-guides
skills.description: Read practical blog guides for Pakistani business owners, including local SEO and listing guidance.

skills.name: list-a-business
skills.description: Explain how a business owner lists on LocalePak: free account at /register, submit at /add-business, choose a tier (Basic PKR 99, Premium PKR 199, Featured PKR 299), pay by Easypaisa, JazzCash or bank transfer, and wait for admin approval. No API submission exists.
